contract.paragraph: NFD recursively applies canonical decomposition and canonical ordering; NFC also applies canonical composition with composition exclusions and blocking. NFKD includes compatibility decomposition, and NFKC composes its result. All four implement algorithmic Hangul decomposition/composition. Normalization is explicit; equality, ordering and hashing remain bytewise.

projection: Each ID and operation emits id/op UTF-8, a space, decimal UTF-8 byte length, colon, exact normalized UTF-8 bytes and LF. Successful exit, no failures/budget/signal/blocked state/roots required. No implicit normalization or casing adaptation. Slice rows use the same oracle input on a nonzero-origin half-open string interval.
